description: Settlement date T+N for a trade date on a joint calendar. Default XNYS,FED with t=1 (US equities since 28 May 2024). If the trade date is not a business day it is first rolled to the next one. Deterministic, no AI. Price: $0.001 USDC per call via x402 (Base); the first 5 calls per day per client are free.

t.description: Settlement lag in business days (0-10). Default 1
